_doc: Methodology orchestration — governs all public methodology surfaces. Not rendered; consumed by harness/methodology_harness.py, agent_deploy.py --methodology, and verify_methodology.py. Keep weights/λ in sync with contract/risk_model.json.

surfaces.role: Short methodology essay on the live index (scroll anchor)
Long-form methodology page — thesis shell, TOC, pipeline + gate

surfaces.output: D.scatterMethod in index payload → entity drawer on Layer/Quadrant tabs
surfaces.role: Contextual methodology chips at point of filter
Source register + tier chart — complements methodology, not duplicate pipeline prose

register.model: Mechanics-first: formulas, tiers, cut rules, pipeline loops. No manifesto voice; no market essay.
register.sync_rule: Sub-factor weights, λ tiers, and quadrant definitions must match risk_model.json and harness/scoring.py.

felix_moves: Two axes before the single number — Exposure × Preparedness → Margin of Safety
Fusion honesty — λ by evidence tier, never LLM axis scores
Layer map — L1–L5 value chain with register-backed examples
Pipeline as named loops — ingest → score → validate → publish (METHODOLOGY §6)
Publication gate visible — L5 measured share from live universe, not stale eval text
Point-of-use methodology — quadrant/layer tabs open drawer, link to full tab

sections.deliver: E/P formula, MoS, quadrant cut rules + live distribution chart
E1–E5 / P1–P5 tables; weights sum to 1.00 per axis
λ table + evidence tiers; match risk_model fusion block
METHODOLOGY §6 loops as stepped flow — no analysis-essay voice
L0–L8 chips from parse_eval_report on each build
Primary register map; tier pills; endpoint links
Four quadrant blurbs + cut-rule text; sync with argument framework cells
L1–L3 layer blurbs for scatter filter tabs

workflow: 3. Fan out parallel passes (one subagent per pass)
4. Merge into contract/methodology_tab.json + sync methodology.json / scatter_methodology.json

bots.ask: Are formulas, weights, λ tiers, and quadrant cut rules correct vs risk_model.json?
bots.output: Prose + tables + chart blocks with {{fact:*}} tokens
bots.ban: Market essay voice; harness LLM claims; stale gate percentages

bots.ask: Do sub-factor names, weights, and rubric anchors match MODEL_SPEC.md and rubric.json?
bots.ban: Invented sub-factors; weights that do not sum to 1.00

bots.ask: Does every measured claim name a primary source, field, and tier?
Does pipeline prose match METHODOLOGY §6 loops and run_loop.py stage names?
bots.ban: Generic MLOps language; eval levels not L0–L8

bots.ask: Are L5 rail entries in-force with correct cite IDs and re-priced sub-factors?
Is provisional status honest given current measured share?
bots.ban: Calling the index measured when L5 gate fails

sync_checks: scatter layers vs methodology_tab layers block
no duplicate pipeline prose in analysis.json
